entities.name: Infinity Globe
entities.description: Single-use etherium devices that let planeswalkers planeswalk with minimal concentration.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who conceived the Infinity Globes on Esper.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who escaped an ambush with Tezzeret and later fought him.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who set an ambush for Tezzeret and Jace.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Plane where the Globes were conceived.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where Tezzeret and Jace fought.

events.summary: Tezzeret conceives the Infinity Globes on Esper after he and Jace barely escape Nicol Bolas's ambush.
events.quote: The Globes were conceived by Tezzeret on Esper

events.summary: The Globes enable Tezzeret and Jace to attack one another in the Blind Eternities.
